title: Prime coefficient constant sheaf identification
statement: Let U be a scheme and r a prime. Put R=ULift(Z/rZ). The constant R-module sheaf with value R/(r), denoted Etale.constantModSheaf R U r, is isomorphic to the constant R-module sheaf with value R [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-sc-constant-sheaves]. This asserts existence of a sheaf isomorphism, not literal equality of the two sheaf objects.

proof.text: The characteristic-r simplification shows Ideal.span {(r : ULift (ZMod r))} = bottom. Apply Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot, convert the linear equivalence with LinearEquiv.toModuleIso, and map this isomorphism through constantSheaf. The result has the required source by unfolding Etale.constantModSheaf.

proof_origin: Lean proof using simp for the zero ideal, Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot, LinearEquiv.toModuleIso and constantSheaf.mapIso; no remaining sorry.

theorem constantModSheaf_iso_constantSheaf {U : Scheme.{u}} (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] :
    Nonempty (Etale.constantModSheaf (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) U r ≅
      (constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
